This PR adds `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, so `.github/` is no longer “only an issue template”. Consider rephrasing this gotcha to the durable point: there are no GitHub Actions workflows under `.github/workflows/`.

In the system-context diagram the developer is described as consuming the library as a Maven dependency, but the relationship label shows an in-repo Gradle project dependency (`implementation project(':rx2dnssd')`). That’s misleading for external consumers and also references only one module while the System node represents the whole library set.

On Git Bash (MINGW/MSYS), `JAVA_HOME` typically needs a slash-separated path (e.g. `C:/Program Files/...` or `/c/Program Files/...`). Using backslashes (`C:\...`) often still fails the Gradle wrapper’s `-x "$JAVA_HOME/bin/java"` check even without embedded quotes, and the verification command here should match that check.

The suggested `JAVA_HOME` value uses Windows backslashes; in Git Bash this often won’t satisfy `./gradlew` because the wrapper checks for an executable at `$JAVA_HOME/bin/java`. Use a slash-separated path (and still avoid embedded quotes).
